description: This file contains functions related to MAC address retrieval, manipulation, and device tree interactions, primarily used in embedded Linux/OpenWrt environments.

methods.name: get_mac_label
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address label from device tree or JSON configuration.

methods.name: find_mtd_chardev
methods.description: Finds the character device path for a given MTD partition.

methods.name: get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Extracts MAC address in ASCII format from a partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_ascii
methods.description: Gets MAC address in ASCII from a specified MTD partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_arcadyan
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address from an encrypted MTD partition using Arcadyan-specific method.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_encrypted_deco
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address from an encrypted MTD partition using Deco-specific method.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_uci_config_ubi
methods.description: Gets MAC address from UCI config stored in UBI volume.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_text
methods.description: Extracts MAC address in text form from a partition at a specific offset.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary
methods.description: Retrieves binary MAC address data from a partition.

methods.name: mtd_get_mac_binary_ubi
methods.description: Retrieves binary MAC address data from a UBI partition.

methods.name: macaddr_add
methods.description: Adds a value to a MAC address's NIC part.

methods.name: macaddr_generate_from_mmc_cid
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the CID of an MMC device.

methods.name: macaddr_geteui
methods.description: Formats MAC address as EUI string.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit
methods.description: Unsets a specific bit in the MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_setbit_la
methods.description: Sets the 'local administration' bit in MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_unsetbit_mc
methods.description: Unsets the 'multicast' bit in MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_random
methods.description: Generates a random MAC address.

methods.name: macaddr_canonicalize
methods.description: Canonicalizes a MAC address to standard format.

methods.name: dt_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a device tree node is enabled.
